property_summary: For any caller other than the deployer, NETM must revert and leave the contract's token balances unchanged; the mutant lets any caller succeed and rewrite balances[owner] to totalDistributed, changing the balances observable via balanceOf.

For any caller, c.NETM() may only succeed when the caller is the deployer, and then balanceOf(caller) equals totalDistributed; the mutant lets any address succeed without that guarantee, breaking the implication.

After any owner invokes NETM(), the owner's token balance must equal totalDistributed (the deployment initial supply credit); the mutant skips crediting balances[owner], so this invariant fails for every owner address.

For any recipient, after the deployer (owner) calls NETM(), the owner is credited with the full totalDistributed amount and can therefore transfer exactly totalDistributed() tokens to any valid recipient; the mutant skips the credit, so that transfer reverts for every recipient.

After the owner initializes the token via NETM(), the owner's token balance must equal totalDistributed (250,000,000e18); the mutant credits totalRemaining instead, making the owner's balance wrong for the same call.
